title: Anthropic Announces Default Activation of Claude Code's Auto Mode to Reduce Manual Approval for Programming Operations

content_html:
Anthropic announced that starting August 14, the Claude Code automatic mode will be enabled by default for Pro, Max, and Team accounts, further reducing the need for manual intervention in AI programming. This mode aims to improve code development efficiency while balancing automated execution capabilities with risk control through security mechanisms.

Anthropic first introduced a test version of the Claude Code automatic mode in March of this year, positioning it as a new interaction method that balances speed and control. In the automatic mode, Claude Code will no longer request user confirmation before each step, but will directly execute tasks when the system determines that the operation does not involve "irreversible, destructive, or external environment-oriented" risks.

Anthropic stated that test results showed the automatic mode outperformed manual review in terms of security detection. In a study involving 1,053 paid testers, the automatic mode identified 89% of harmful behaviors, while manual review detected only 13.6%. The company noted that manual review might lead to habitual approvals due to long-term use, with users approving 97% of Claude Code's permission requests during the test.

Boris Cherny, head of Claude Code, said his team has been using the automatic mode for a long time and stated they can no longer return to a development approach reliant on permission prompts. At the same time, Anthropic continues to improve its security system, including adding a fast injection filtering mechanism and customizable hard rejection rules to reduce risks such as data leaks.

As AI programming assistants gradually evolve toward agent-like capabilities, the balance between automated execution and security constraints has become a key focus for the industry. This adjustment by Claude Code also reflects the evolution of AI development tools from assisting programming to higher autonomy in task execution.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic 宣布，从 8 月 14 日起，Pro、Max 和 Team 账户将默认启用 Claude Code 自动模式，进一步减少 AI 编程中的人工干预。 该模式旨在提高代码开发效率，同时通过安全机制平衡自动化执行能力和风险控制。

Anthropic于今年3月首次推出了Claude Code自动模式的测试版本，将其定位为一种平衡速度和控制的新型交互方式。 在自动模式下，Claude Code在每一步之前将不再要求用户确认，而是在系统确定操作不涉及“不可逆的、破坏性的或面向外部环境的”风险时直接执行任务。

Anthropic表示，测试结果显示，自动模式在安全检测方面优于人工审核。 在一项涉及 1,053 名付费测试人员的研究中，自动模式识别出 89% 的有害行为，而手动审核仅识别出 13.6%。 该公司指出，人工审核可能会因长期使用而导致习惯性批准，测试期间用户批准了 Claude Code 97% 的权限请求。

Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 表示，他的团队长期以来一直在使用自动模式，并表示他们不能再回到依赖权限提示的开发方式。 同时，Anthropic不断完善其安全系统，包括添加快速注入过滤机制和可定制的硬拒绝规则，以降低数据泄露等风险。

随着AI编程助手逐渐向类似代理的能力发展，自动化执行与安全约束之间的平衡已成为业界关注的重点。 Claude Code的这一调整也体现了AI开发工具从辅助编程向任务执行更高自主性的演变。
